en.title: InstructMesh: Selective Refinement of Generative 3D Models for Fabrication
en.hook: A novel technique to selectively refine generative 3D meshes for high geometric accuracy in fabrication.
key_takeaways: Addresses the geometric inaccuracy of visual-first generative 3D models
Introduces selective mesh refinement specifically tailored for fabrication
Achieves a balance between visual plausibility and structural integrity

zh.title: InstructMesh：面向制造的生成式3D模型选择性精炼
zh.hook: 精准修复过度侧重视觉合理性而忽视几何精度的生成式3D模型的底层技术。
key_takeaways: 克服文本或图像生成3D模型在几何精度上的根本缺陷
提出专为实际制造设计网格（Mesh）选择性精炼的新方法
实现视觉逼真度与结构几何准确性的完美平衡
